notes: PR136 compares the original launch-beta rendered brief with the PR135 enriched version.
PR136 does not modify either brief and does not enrich a second case.
The comparison is provisional and not human validation.

comparison_questions.question: Is the enriched brief clearer about what changed for action?
comparison_questions.read: The enriched version makes the private-pilot action consequence easier to connect to buyer behavior, thresholds, and evidence gates.

comparison_questions.question: Does it better distinguish what Lolla sharpened from what may already have been present?
comparison_questions.read: The added section explicitly says the starting direction may already have leaned away from a simple public launch and narrows the sharpened contribution to proof-producing buyer behavior and stop rules.

comparison_questions.question: Does it preserve uncertainty?
comparison_questions.read: The enriched version keeps high uncertainty on starting direction and source-depth limits near the added interpretation.

comparison_questions.question: Does it preserve non-claims?
comparison_questions.read: The enriched version repeats that it does not prove better advice, product value, answer quality, human validation, or agent authorization.

comparison_questions.question: Does it add useful context or just more text?
comparison_questions.read: The added context is useful because it explains the role of interpretation, but it also adds length that should be watched in later cases.

comparison_questions.question: Does it make the brief more overconfident?
comparison_questions.read: The added prose is careful, but any smoother conversation story can make provisional interpretation feel more settled than it is.

comparison_questions.question: Does it remain readable for a busy decision-maker?
comparison_questions.read: The main body remains readable, though the new section should stay short in future examples.

comparison_questions.question: Does it keep evidence/source limits visible?
comparison_questions.read: The Evidence and limits section names source refs, checked-in-safe mode, private content absence, and excluded fields.

comparison_questions.question: Should enrichment be tested on a second case?
comparison_questions.read: One case is too thin for rules. A second case can show whether the same enrichment shape works outside enterprise GTM.

reader_value_assessment.overall_read: The enriched brief appears more useful as a user-facing artifact because it explains why the process matters for action rather than only restating the final action.
reader_value_assessment.strongest_added_value: It distinguishes a starting direction that may already have been present from the narrower action consequence the audit appears to have sharpened.
reader_value_assessment.busy_reader_value: A busy reader can see that the private-pilot recommendation is tied to proof-producing buyer behavior, thresholds, and evidence gates.
reader_value_assessment.added_length_risk: The extra section is acceptable in this example but should not grow into a second appendix.

uncertainty_and_nonclaim_assessment.notes: The enriched version keeps checked-in-safe source limits and human-validation absence visible.

overclaim_assessment.strongest_overclaim_risk: The phrase-level clarity of the enriched section can make provisional interpretation feel like settled conversation truth.
overclaim_assessment.why_not_blocking: The enriched brief explicitly says it does not prove Lolla improved the decision or that the private pilot is better advice.
overclaim_assessment.required_next_guardrail: A second enriched case should use the same exclusions and keep the interpretation section compact.

decision_gate.rationale: The enrichment appears to improve reader understanding without a major overclaim, but one case is not enough to formalize rules. A second enriched brief is the right next evidence slice.

next_recommendation.recommended_next_pr: PR137 Second Enriched Brief Test v0
next_recommendation.recommended_action: Apply the same conservative enrichment rules to the deploy-assisted-intake-routing rendered brief using the PR132 interpretation read.
do_not_do_next: Do not formalize enrichment rules from one case.
Do not integrate enrichment into runtime.
Do not create a new interpretation read.
Do not treat the enriched brief as human validated.
